village = a small group of houses in the country
town = a place larger than a village but smaller than a city
city = a large, important town
urban = connected with towns and cities
rural = connected with the countryside
noisy = making a lot of loud sound
quiet = with little noise
tidy up = to put things in their places and make a room neat
do the laundry = to wash dirty clothes
hoover = to clean the floor with a vacuum cleaner (British informal)
dust = to wipe away the grey powder that collects on furniture
do the ironing = to make washed clothes smooth with an iron
make the bed = to tidy the covers on a bed after you get up
take the bins out = to carry rubbish containers outside for collection
move in = to start living in a new home
move out = to leave a home and stop living there
share a room = to sleep in the same bedroom as another person
view = what you can see from a window
location = the place where something is
